title: Show a documented engineering project lifecycle
append: Separate Alberta procurement records show the range of work behind an engineering project. A 2025 bridge-and-culvert contract awarded to ISL included design, construction supervision, and post-construction and warranty inspections. In July 2026, Strathmore awarded ISL reservoir-expansion design work and listed its Calgary office. The reservoir brief asks for a construction plan that maintains water service. These are separate projects from Calgary’s 144 Avenue NW extension.
delta: Adds purchaser-documented tasks, a Calgary office award, and continuity-of-service constraints.
cautions: 2025 bridge award names Edmonton; do not assign it to Calgary staff. Strathmore is outside Calgary. An award does not establish construction completion or hiring.
before: ISL was the City of Calgary’s prime consultant for planning, detailed design and construction work on the 144 Avenue NW extension. Its project account describes steep terrain, a single-span bridge over West Nose Creek, creek work and multi-use pathways. This creates a local example of design constraints interacting, rather than a story about choosing the shortest line on a map.

title: Explain why replacement parts must fit the existing system
append: A February 2025 University of Alberta award names Spartan Controls at its Calgary address as the supplier of control valves for large heat exchangers. The university specified matching replacements because another make or model would require changes to the existing piping. This is an example of engineering compatibility: a replacement component has to work with the wider system. These control valves are distinct from pressure-relief devices.
delta: Adds independent customer evidence and a clear design-constraint example.
cautions: The customer is in Edmonton. The record establishes supply, not installation by Calgary staff or a current vacancy. OPEN status is misleading here; award entries and notice flags establish the award.
before: Spartan Controls describes valve diagnostics, repair, commissioning and specialised testing. Its service page explicitly identifies Calgary repair and steam-testing capability.
